content: Analyze this NestJS project and provide a structured summary of modules, flow, ORM usage, error handling, logging, tests, config, extension points and files to modify for JWT, logging and validation.
Analyze the Docker setup of this project including services, communication, env vars, build strategy and suggest improvements.
Analyze this React + Vite project and propose a scalable structure, libraries, API integration strategy and patterns for error handling and state.
Implement validation and error handling in NestJS using ValidationPipe, DTO decorators, ParseIntPipe and NotFoundException. Keep it simple and adjust tests.
Implement a NestJS logging interceptor that logs request start, response, duration, and errors. Apply it globally using Logger.
Implement JWT authentication in NestJS using AuthModule, JwtStrategy, AuthGuard, and a login endpoint with a hardcoded user and token generation.
Extend the domain to support TodoItems with a OneToMany relationship to TodoList, including DTO validation and nested creation logic.
Build a React + Vite frontend using Material UI with API integration, login handling, TodoLists view, and CRUD creation UI.
Extend the frontend to support full CRUD operations for TodoLists and TodoItems including edit, delete, and toggle completed state with a clean UX.
Analyze the external Todo API documentation and summarize data models, endpoints, limitations, and implications for synchronization.
Based on the external API and local system, propose a simple synchronization architecture including directions, reconciliation, error handling, and performance strategy.
Implement a sync mechanism in NestJS that pulls TodoLists from an external API and creates missing records locally with logging and error handling.
Fix sync error handling by wrapping external API calls in try/catch, logging failures, and returning safely without crashing.
Extend the sync implementation to include retry logic, result reporting (created, failed), and better logging output.
Add scheduled sync using @nestjs/schedule with a cron job executing every 5 minutes while keeping manual sync endpoint.
Add a frontend sync button that triggers /sync endpoint, shows loading state, and displays result using Material UI alerts or snackbar.
Ensure /sync endpoint always returns a consistent response format with success, createdLocal, createdExternal, updatedExternal, failed, including error scenarios.
Extend sync to support bidirectional synchronization: external to local and local to external, including create and update operations for lists and items with retry and logging.

Audit README.md against the codebase and fix inconsistencies. Ensure sync is described as bidirectional and add a Production Improvements section including ID mapping, timestamps, queues, and conflict resolution.
Generate a professional README.md describing architecture, features, sync strategy, trade-offs, and AI-first development approach.
Reconstruct all prompts used during development grouped by stages: backend setup, validation, logging, auth, domain, frontend, UI, and sync features.

Optimize React UI rendering for very large TodoItem lists using react-window virtualization. Document integration in README-Gustavo-Hernandez.md, add a row renderer example, and add React Testing Library tests for visible item rendering, scrolling, and stable performance.

Add scripts/seed_todo_items.sql: psql-compatible SQL that deletes existing todo items for todoListId=1 and inserts 100000 items using generate_series, name 'Task #n', completed=false. Include a Jest integration test src/todo_lists/seed_todo_items.spec.ts that runs the script and asserts count 100000 (skips if DB unavailable).
